messages:
lucas: Hey everyone, just onboarded — trying to clone git@repo.corp.redwood:team/infra.git but it stalls during transfer. I can SSH to bastion-us-1 and `ssh -J lucas@bastion-us-1 git@repo.corp.redwood` works interactively, but `git clone` from WSL2 hangs at 'Receiving objects:  0%' and then ultimately fails with 'Connection reset by peer'. Using the WireGuard split-tunnel profile provided in the onboarding packet.
emily: welcome! :wave: quick Q: does `ssh -vT` show anything useful when git tries to connect via ProxyJump?
lucas: here's the relevant tail of `ssh -vT` when cloning (via WSL bash):
```
debug1: channel 0: free: client-session, nchannels 1
debug1: channel 0: send open
Connection reset by 10.45.3.22 port 22
```
not very helpful.
netops: thanks — WSL2 + WireGuard often hits MTU/path-MTU issues with TCP over UDP tunnel. Two quick checks: `ip link show wg0` and `ping -M do -s 1400 10.45.3.22` (from WSL). Can you paste results?
lucas: `ip link show wg0` shows mtu 1420. Ping with 1400 returns "Frag needed and DF set" / no reply.
netops: yep, that matches. Workarounds:
1) Lower the MTU on wg0: `sudo ip link set dev wg0 mtu 1400` (or 1280 for flaky networks).
2) In the Windows WireGuard client edit profile and set `MTU = 1400` so WSL inherits it.
3) If you can't change MTU, enable MSS clamping on the gateway (we can do server-side iptables rule) to force TCP MSS to safe value.
helpdesk-bot: Created ticket NET-2345: "WSL2 WireGuard MTU causing git clone failures for new hires" and assigned to @netops.
lucas: changed wg0 mtu to 1400 in WSL (`sudo ip link set dev wg0 mtu 1400`) and retried `git clone` 1 -> clone completed. Huge relief.
emily: awesome. can you confirm `ip link show wg0` now shows mtu 1400? also which Windows build? we'll add to the onboarding doc with the exact steps.
lucas: confirmed wg0 mtu 1400. Windows 11 22H2, WSL2.
netops: cool, we'll push a default WG profile with MTU 1400 for WSL users and add an FAQ about MTU/pmtu hits. If other folks hit this, the temporary fix is to set MTU or use `ssh -D 1080 -J lucas@bastion-us-1` and set SOCKS proxy for git via `git config --global http.proxy socks5h://localhost:1080` for HTTPS clones.
emily: adding short note to onboarding checklist and linking NET-2345. thanks @lucas for debugging! :white_check_mark:
infra: added a line to the internal docs: "WSL2 users: if SSH/git transfers fail, try lowering WireGuard MTU to 1400 or contact netops."
lucas: thanks all, super smooth onboarding so far.
